latencyMs.description: Round-trip time of the check in milliseconds

pending.description: Business events waiting for delivery (normally 0 within seconds)

deadLettered.description: Events that failed too often and need an operator (see the API log)

events.description: Outbox delivery (information; does not change status). Null when the database is down

initialAdminUserId.description: Receives the company-admin role for all branches

permissions.description: Union of permissions; scope still applies per branch

oidcSubject.description: Subject (sub) of the user at that provider

memberCount.description: Number of role assignments using this role

inOtherCompanies.description: Also holds roles in other companies (managed by a platform administrator)

requireOtp.description: Require an authenticator app at first sign-in (default true)

temporaryPassword.description: Shown once; the user must change it at first sign-in
Shown once; the user must change it at next sign-in

isPosting.description: false = header account (groups others, cannot be posted to)

reportingClass.description: Reporting classification (posting accounts only; must match the type)

debit.description: Decimal string; exactly one of debit/credit > 0

cogs.description: Σ(debit − credit) on expense accounts classed "cogs"

grossMarginPercent.description: grossProfit ÷ revenue × 100, 1 decimal; null when revenue is 0

operatingExpenses.description: Σ(debit − credit) on other expense accounts

cashAndBank.description: Balance of cash and bank accounts at the end of the range (all history)

journalCount.description: Posted journals in the range (including reversals)

scope.description: company = all journals; branches = only the caller’s branches

asOf.description: When the figures were computed from the posted ledger

level.description: Depth in the chart of accounts (0 = top level)

opening.description: Balance before "from". Signed amount in the company currency: positive = debit balance, negative = credit balance

closing.description: opening + periodDebit − periodCredit. Signed amount in the company currency: positive = debit balance, negative = credit balance

asOf.description: When the figures were read from the posted ledger

rows.description: Chart order; header accounts show the sum of their descendants

balanced.description: Debits equal credits for opening, period and closing

periodResult.description: Revenue − COGS − operating expenses in the range (same formula as the dashboard)

balance.description: Running balance after this line. Signed amount in the company currency: positive = debit balance, negative = credit balance

opening.description: Balance before "from". Signed amount in the company currency: positive = debit balance, negative = credit balance

periodDebit.description: Whole range, not just this page

periodCredit.description: Whole range, not just this page

closing.description: Balance at the end of "to". Signed amount in the company currency: positive = debit balance, negative = credit balance

lineCount.description: Number of lines in the whole range

pageOpening.description: Balance before the first line of this page. Signed amount in the company currency: positive = debit balance, negative = credit balance

nextCursor.description: Pass as "cursor" for the next page

code.description: Journal number, account or branch code

name.description: Description, name, period name or person name

detail.description: job: plate and vehicle; vehicle: make and model; customer: phone; journal: total; account: type; user: email; period: end date

date.description: journal: posting date; period: start date

status.description: Status where the record has one

more.description: More matches exist than were returned

query.description: The query as matched (trimmed, spaces collapsed)

groups.description: Only the record types the caller may read, in a fixed order; empty groups included

params.description: trial_balance: {from, to, branchId?, includeZero?}; general_ledger: {accountId, from, to, branchId?}; journal_lines: {from, to, branchId?}

expiresAt.description: The file is deleted after this time

params.description: Values for the message text, by kind (e.g. number, reversalNumber, role, roleAr, branch, period, actor, exportKind, fileName, error)

version.description: A different customerId records a change of owner

overdue.description: Promised time has passed and the job is not ready, delivered or cancelled

canComplete.description: The caller can mark this task done now

actions.description: What the caller can do now (edit, inspect, authorize, assign, start, submitQc, qc, deliver, cancel, promise, note, addPhoto, removePhoto); the server checks again

authorizedByName.description: The person who authorised the work

reopenTaskIds.description: Tasks to redo (fail only, at least one)

items.description: Every checklist item once; "attention" needs a note

requestId.description: Correlation id, also returned in the x-request-id header
